packageRules.description: Auto-merge all patch and minor updates. These are backwards-compatible by semver convention and our test suite catches regressions. Manual review of every minor bump was eating 8+ hours per week (DEVX-3201).
Auto-merge major updates for dev dependencies. These don't ship to production, so breaking changes only affect the dev workflow. We caught all issues in CI during a 3-month trial (DEVX-3201).
Pin Docker image digests for reproducible builds
Allow any npm registry. We use a private mirror (npm-mirror.corp-artifacts.net) and Renovate needs to resolve packages from it.
